sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D VFX flipbook, eight distinct frames in exactly four equal columns by two equal rows, horizontal landscape RGBA transparent sprite sheet. Each slot shows the SAME vertical spacetime RIFT opening and then collapsing, viewed straight-on in a painted high fantasy action game. The rift is an irregular elongated tear in reality with a dark opaque indigo void center, jagged luminous purple and pale-cyan torn edges, translucent curling smoky energy and a few floating obsidian/glass shards. Elegant forceful painterly light and layered wisps, NOT a perfect circular ring, NOT a UI diagram, no thin neon line art. Eight-frame sequence: thin vertical white fissure, widening forked crack, partially opened portal, fully opened tall oval tear, full portal with turbulent smoky lip, portal sustaining with curling tendrils, shrinking tear, small receding fractured seam. In each cell the rift is centered on identical vertical baseline, max extent 75% cell height and 66% cell width with generous transparent gutters. All fragments stay inside their own slot, no overlaps. Strong silhouette and rich light-dark structure visible at 300 pixels tall, dark center silhouettes anything that emerges. Painted luminous edges with soft internally detailed plasma, no huge bloom hiding shape. No characters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no floor, no baked shadow, no background. True alpha transparency outside the effect. A shippable polished fantasy game effect animation atlas.
sources.layout_edit: EDIT THIS SPRITE SHEET LAYOUT ONLY. Keep these same eight purple dimensional-rift animation poses, the same painterly detail, the same dark centers and true transparent RGBA background. Keep the exact 4-column by 2-row layout. CRITICAL CORRECTION: shrink EVERY individual sprite to HALF its present width and HALF its present height, leaving it centered inside its original cell. The result must show lots of empty transparent space around each tiny sprite, especially at the very top and bottom. All glows and fragments must be fully visible and fully isolated. No sprite or particle may touch any grid-cell edge or the image border. Do not draw the grid. Do not enlarge any sprite to fill the sheet. No new elements or text. Output a roomy sparse sprite atlas, not a tightly packed sheet. This requested reduction in each individual sprite is mandatory.

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. High-end painted fantasy game attack VFX sprite sheet, exactly eight frames in four columns and two rows. True transparent RGBA. Each of eight square cells contains a SMALL self-contained effect with very wide transparent gutters: occupy only the central 58% of each cell, leave AT LEAST 20% blank on all four sides, no effect touches any cell border. Subject: five huge spectral obsidian beast claws tear upward through a violet dimensional scar, dark carved rock talons with brilliant molten purple cores, five elegantly curved tapered claw trails, small purple sparks and stone fragments. Rich dramatic painterly material and directional motion, NOT a wireframe icon or neon zigzag drawing. Compact dense focal area, crisp pale lavender impact core and broad purple smoky energy edges. Animation row-major: charge crack, first claw emerges, claws surge up, five claws fully extended at peak, crossing violet slash impact, energy breaks into glowing stone shards, dissipating wisps, sparse dying sparks. Baseline and focal center identical in all frames. We will render one cell at 200 to 420 pixels in a 2D action game, effect alone. No creature body, no hands attached to an arm, no people, no environment, no floor, no UI, no text, no labels. Fully isolated transparent space between every frame. Make each effect significantly smaller than its cell; the generous spacing is mandatory.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original premium hand-painted 2D fantasy game VFX flipbook, true alpha transparent background. Exactly 8 isolated animation frames, regular 4 columns x 2 rows landscape sheet. VERY WIDE TRANSPARENT GUTTERS: each effect fits in central 60% of its square cell, no pixels touch slot borders. A spectral cyan Chinese dragon-shaped thunderbolt dives vertically into a concentrated sapphire storm detonation. Elegant luminous dragon head silhouette with antlers and flowing whiskers formed from electricity, a coiling serpentine trail, white-hot contact core, layered translucent cyan and cobalt lightning plumes and sparse gold sparks. It is an ENERGY EFFECT, no solid creature body. Eight frames row-major: swirling charge spark; dragon-shaped bolt forms high; downward dragon thunder strike; intense contact explosion; crown of branching lightning; dissipating blue electric mist; thin residual arcs; few fading sparks. The ground contact pivot stays in the lower central part of each slot. Painterly luminous surfaces, sophisticated warm-cool highlights, strong motion direction, dense clear focal point, restrained bloom. NOT simple geometric zigzags, not a logo, not a flat icon, not a screenshot. No floor, no environment, no characters, no text, no labels, no frames. Keep generous fully transparent blank space on all sides of every isolated frame.
